steps.message:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-12, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1228.3 | 0.41 | 0.41
2 | 678.3 | 0.50 | 0.91
3 | 2104.5 | 0.76 | 1.67
4 | 3417.4 | 29.87 | 31.54
5 | 3516.3 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation, we first identify the resistivity for each layer:
- $r_1 = 1228.3\ \Omega\text{m}$
- $r_2 = 678.3\ \Omega\text{m}$
- $r_3 = 2104.5\ \Omega\text{m}$
- $r_4 = 3417.4\ \Omega\text{m}$
- $r_5 = 3516.3\ \Omega\text{m}$

Next, we group them into consecutive sets of three to determine the letter for each group:

1.  **Layers 1-2-3:** $r_1 = 1228.3, r_2 = 678.3, r_3 = 2104.5$.
    Since $r_1 > r_2 < r_3$ ($1228.3 > 678.3$ and $678.3 < 2104.5$), the letter is **H**.

2.  **Layers 2-3-4:** $r_2 = 678.3, r_3 = 2104.5, r_4 = 3417.4$.
    Since $r_2 < r_3 < r_4$ ($678.3 < 2104.5$ and $2104.5 < 3417.4$), the letter is **A**.

3.  **Layers 3-4-5:** $r_3 = 2104.5, r_4 = 3417.4, r_5 = 3516.3$.
    Since $r_3 < r_4 < r_5$ ($2104.5 < 3417.4$ and $3417.4 < 3516.3$), the letter is **A**.

Combining these letters in order, we get **HAA**.

{"curve_type": "HAA"}
